scope: LuHm OS / KAI 9000 project history, active GitHub architecture, Samsung Android donor, game donors, AI providers, signing, F-Droid publication, rooted lab separation, and physical-device release gates

overall.reason: Source architecture has been materially hardened, but final GREEN still requires merge/CI evidence, persistent signing identities, a current signed public F-Droid repository, and physical S24 FE install/launch/update proof.

passes.name: Source-of-Truth and branch authority
findings: luhmos-main remains canonical integration branch
current hardening lives on sanctioned luhmos/backend PR #34
historical chat decisions are subordinate to current Git contracts
legacy package/release workflows were active and have now been fail-closed
passes.green_requires: PR #34 merged after required CI is green

passes.name: Device and privilege separation
findings: S24 FE stock production lane is no-root and standalone
SM-X400 rooted laboratory uses separate package identity art.eggiebagelface.luhmos.rooted
rooted lab assumes the device is already intentionally rooted
no automatic rooting or exploit delivery is part of LuHm OS
passes.green_requires: stock release CI and rooted-lab implementation each prove their own isolated package/signing boundaries

passes.name: Package, version, and update lineage
findings: stock production package is art.eggiebagelface.luhmos
baseline is 1.0.0 versionCode 100
same-signer update proof target is 1.0.1 versionCode 101
art.eggiebagelface.videoforge.dev, art.eggiebagelface.kai9000.dev, and art.eggiebagelface.kai9000 are historical only
legacy workflows that could forge those identities are blocked

passes.name: Signing, secrets, and trust identities
findings: APK signing alias is luhmos-release
F-Droid repository signing alias is luhmos-fdroid-repo
APK and F-Droid repository use separate trust identities
new F-Droid signing script refuses to re-sign a mismatched APK
private material is forbidden from Git, APK, public F-Droid branch, logs, and model context
current public APK certificate and repository fingerprints are not yet sealed for the new LuHm OS package line
passes.green_requires: identity-proof release run succeeds and public certificate fingerprints are pinned as repository variables

passes.name: Reproducible Android build forge
findings: Godot 4.7.2 editor/export-template checksums are pinned
Gradle distribution checksum is pinned
npm lockfile mutation is rejected
Android SDK/build-tools 36.1.0 and target SDK 36 are explicit
production workflow exports --export-release instead of debug
passes.green_requires: new release workflow completes from current source and produces verified persistent-signed artifact evidence

passes.name: Android manifest, WebView, and runtime attack surface
findings: audit found production donor still declared Termux RUN_COMMAND and Termux package query
audit removed Termux permission/query and widget daemon control
audit removed localhost health dependency
WebView now denies mixed content, cookies, popup JavaScript, geolocation, and database storage
external WebView navigation is limited to https and mailto
appassets origin-locked message bridge remains
passes.green_requires: hardened donor compiles and current release APK verification proves no Termux permission/package content and no debuggable flag

passes.name: Game/JRPG/dating donor ownership and licensing
findings: owned Godot donor is pinned to eggie-admin/3d-chat-interface commit 457c31f2bcb040aba3d6a0b36a25cf1a63587359
kuryart/godot-jrpg is tracked as MIT third-party framework reference
nathanhoad/godot_dialogue_manager is tracked as MIT third-party dialogue reference
sample/external media is not automatically reclassified as LuHm-owned material
asset distribution requires source, owner, license, and attribution/provenance

passes.name: AI providers, privacy, and authority boundaries
findings: OpenAI and Hugging Face are optional network adapters, not boot dependencies
current OpenAI references are gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-5.6-sol through Responses API
Hugging Face reference models and router are configuration rather than architecture constants
no cloud vendor credential belongs in the APK
cross-provider replay is not silent
AI cannot self-authorize signing, root, release, or arbitrary shell
passes.green_requires: latest source CI/provider smoke passes after the hardening branch changes

passes.name: F-Droid repository, metadata, and public publication
findings: stale Video Forge F-Droid manifests were replaced with canonical art.eggiebagelface.luhmos coordinates
release requires signed index-v2 and v1 compatibility indexes
public zero-secret bootstrap origin is fdroid-public branch on raw.githubusercontent.com
fdroid.eggiebagelface.art is a branded mirror target rather than the critical first-install dependency
stock metadata declares RequiresRoot false and rooted lab is a separate package
old v6/v7 signed Video Forge repository is historical and invalid as LuHm OS release proof
passes.green_requires: current LuHm OS release APK and F-Droid indexes are persistently signed and the fdroid-public branch is published over HTTPS

passes.name: Physical S24 FE install, launcher, F-Droid provenance, update, and recovery
findings: device verifier now uses ADB instead of Termux
final proof checks SM-S721U1 SDK36, F-Droid installer source, exact versionCode, launcher resolution/start, and public repository signature
final GREEN requires baseline 100 install followed by same-package versionCode 101 upgrade
passes.green_requires: run baseline-check and upgrade-check against the physical SM-S721U1 after current signed public repo publication

critical_blockers: PR #34 is not yet merged into luhmos-main
hardened Samsung donor PR #20 has not yet produced/merged CI evidence, although the production workflow pins its exact hardening commit
persistent LuHm OS APK signing secret availability is not yet proven by the new release workflow
persistent LuHm OS F-Droid repository signing secret availability is not yet proven by the new release workflow
new production release workflow has not yet completed
fdroid-public branch does not yet contain the new canonical signed repository
physical S24 FE F-Droid install/launcher/update proof is not yet recorded
retired_as_release_authority: legacy v6/v7 Video Forge signed F-Droid bundles
debug or ephemeral signatures as production proof
